body:
I have several mental illnesses, including chronic anxiety, clinical depression, and psychosis. It is for this last ailment that I have recently been prescribed olanzapine.
I don't feel anything. Nothing. And I can't tell you what a relief that is after years of mental anguish. I spend most of my free time simply existing. Taking in one breath after another. Watching the rain fall, the clouds drift by...it is a pure state of emptiness. I hope it lasts until the day I die.
